purpose: Fail-closed diagnostic of whether projective transfer plus generic local gradient snapping can reproducibly reconstruct the missing source-native 169/375/416 observation package for the v107 shared-center solve.

diagnostic_four_state_fit_using_auto_sna.reason_non_authoritative: Several court-family snaps reach or nearly reach the +/-4 px local search boundary; the reconstructed court observations therefore fail source-native observation quality before metric fitting.
diagnostic_four_state_fit_using_auto_sna.interpretation: Reject the automatic observation-recovery method. Do NOT interpret this pathological root or the 1116.5 cm support shift as evidence that the physical Right Slash camera itself fails v107.

decision.required_before_any_new_right_slash_acce: Recover or deterministically re-extract the exact source-native 169/375/416 regulation-line observations with per-family native-pixel QA; only then run full v107/v109 nominal, multistart, support-reduction, +/-0.5 px perturbation, and held-out rim/board/court QA.
